metadata.time_grid: t_j=12*(j+1)/n; time zero excluded; fixed horizon 12
metadata.covariance_model: STYLIZED known stationary latent AR(1) covariance plus independent nugget; no claim of measured error covariance
metadata.covariance_units: latent and nugget variances each 0.00125 concentration-units squared; total pointwise noise SD 0.05
metadata.rho_interpretation: correlation of latent errors per candidate-grid interval; holding rho fixed while changing n changes physical correlation scale
metadata.prior_interpretation: fixed 0.01 I in the stated log-parameter coordinates; regularizes the design criterion
metadata.statistical_scope: local mean Fisher information at nominal parameters with fixed known covariance; no parameter-dependent covariance derivatives
metadata.exact_certificate_scope: compatible with certification of the saved decimal sensitivity and covariance data; no claim that floating analytic sensitivities are exact real values
metadata.dense_baseline: ordinary dense Liu evaluator, split .99 and at most 200 root cuts; same cap and disclosed best-hull incumbent start

analytic_sensitivity_check.method: independent complex step on mean formula
